title: Contact Mr Wallcover | Wallcovering Installer London
description: Contact Mr Wallcover, the London wallcovering installer founded by Dorin Burcus. Email info@mrwallcover.com, or start a project with the enquiry form.
heading: Contact Mr Wallcover.
lede: Write, call or send a message, whichever suits you. Dorin Burcus reads the email and answers the phone himself.
ledeNoPhone: Email is the simplest way in. It is read by Dorin Burcus himself.

email.heading: Email
email.text: For questions, photographs, drawings and specifications. Attachments are welcome.

phone.heading: Phone
phone.text: Dorin Burcus answers the phone himself. Select the button below to see the number.

whatsapp.heading: WhatsApp
whatsapp.text: Send a message, with photographs of the walls or the paper label if you have them.

call.heading: A 20-minute call
call.text: Choose a time in the calendar to talk the project through.

instagram.heading: Instagram
instagram.text: Recent installations and work in progress.

project.heading: Starting a project?
project.text: For a quotation, the enquiry form asks for the few things that shape the price: the building, the rooms, the material and the timing. Photographs and drawings help, and are optional.

areas.heading: Where we work
areas.text: We work in London and the surrounding areas, and UK-wide on selected projects.
